probes.name: Compact directory
probes.thesis: A compact readable native directory on the wider left shares one horizontal plane with a narrower always-open updates→AI column. Product links are primary; service capability stays exposed without a five-provider text row or repeat prompt chips.
probes.layout: Desktop1.5:1 directory/services split, three14px native route columns, updates first and AI under one restrained rule. Phone stacks full-width product directory, updates, AI, then unchanged wordmark/art and one final studio line.
probes.typography: Exact native Georgia Atlas forest/paper/coral; CodeVetter system sans black/white/amber. One giant P1 wordmark remains anchored in terminal art; small native identity line above routes. Native secondary links14px40/44px targets; controls16px; visible question/consent12px.

probes.name: Editorial split
probes.thesis: Native product destinations become large editorial links on the left, with quieter resources/connect rows beneath. The right starts with one composed question/icon dock, then a compact opt-in form. Hierarchy comes from scale and placement, rather than adding stacked pitch sections.
probes.layout: Desktop1.28:1 editorial/product-services split. Left primary links28px Atlas/25px Code, secondary14px resource/contact groups. Right question/icons first, updates beneath one rule. Phone preserves hierarchy with no oversized app identity; compact app lowers primary-link scale.
probes.typography: Exact native Georgia Atlas forest/paper/coral; CodeVetter system sans black/white/amber. One giant P1 wordmark remains anchored in terminal art; small native identity line above routes. Native secondary links14px40/44px targets; controls16px; visible question/consent12px.

probes.name: Quiet utility panel
probes.thesis: Native product routes are the left anchor; a single restrained right-hand panel contains an editable assistant composer with an integrated icon dock and open email updates. The terminal signature fades into the retained illustration, followed only by one studio line.
probes.layout: Wider three-column product directory on left; restrained ruled right utility panel; question and icons share a native field boundary, with compact updates beneath. Tablet two route columns; phone product links then utilities. One literal bottom line scrolls locally.
probes.typography: Native Atlas Georgia/forest/paper/coral and CodeVetter ink/white/amber retained. Middle uses readable 14px routes, quiet 12px group labels, 16px question/email and 17px utility headings. Terminal P1 wordmark/art unchanged.

ownerEvidence.quote: The left section would be the actual footer for the product. The right section would be the product updates and AI chat. We would have a nice image. At the very bottom we will have one simple strip and nothing more.
